title: Split heads, merge heads, multi-head attention
summary: Reshape (B, T, D) into H heads and back, then run batched multi-head self-attention with given projection matrices.

mutants.no_max_shift: Calls np.exp on the raw scores, so large activations overflow to infinity.
mutants.no_output_projection: Returns the merged heads and forgets to multiply by w_o.
mutants.reshape_no_transpose: Splits with x.reshape(B, H, T, d_head) and no transpose, so the head axis mixes tokens and features.
mutants.scale_by_d_model: Divides the scores by sqrt(D), not by sqrt(d_head).
mutants.softmax_wrong_axis: Takes the softmax over the query axis, not over the key axis.
mutants.strided_heads: Gives head h the columns h, h + H, h + 2H and so on, not one block of d_head neighbor columns.
